ruleDefinitions.name: Import LDAP Data Interchange Format File Via Ldifde.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the execution of "Ldifde.exe" with the import flag "-i". The can be abused to include HTTP-based arguments which will allow the arbitrary download of files from a remote server.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\ldifde\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "ldifde\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-i.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-f.*")))
